meta.name: alterlab-lamindb
meta.description: Manage, annotate, and trace biological data with LaminDB, an open-source FAIR data framework that makes datasets queryable, versioned, and reproducible. Use when registering or querying biological datasets (scRNA-seq, spatial, flow cytometry), validating and curating data against ontologies (genes, cell types, diseases, tissues), tracking data lineage and computational workflows, building data lakehouses, or wiring integrations with Nextflow, Snakemake, W&B, or MLflow. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 管理、注释和溯源生物数据，让数据集可查询、可版本化、可复现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理单细胞测序、空间转录组等生物数据，需要保证数据可复现
copy.tagline_en: Manage, annotate, and trace biological data with versioned, queryable datasets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with scRNA-seq, spatial, or flow cytometry data and need reproducibility

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 LaminDB 管理、查询和标注生物数据（如单细胞测序、流式细胞术），自动追踪数据来源和计算流程，并验证数据是否符合标准。
howto.when: 当你需要注册或查询生物数据集、验证数据与本体（如基因、细胞类型）的一致性、或追踪数据分析流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 LaminDB 注册这个单细胞数据集，并标注细胞类型。
查询所有来自 PBMC 组织、经过处理的数据集。
say.note: Claude 会使用 LaminDB 的过滤功能返回结果。

say.text: 追踪这个分析流程的数据来源。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage, query, and annotate biological data using LaminDB, automatically track data lineage and computational workflows, and validate data against standards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to register or query biological datasets, validate data against ontologies (e.g., genes, cell types), or track data lineage and workflows.

say_en.text: Register this single-cell dataset with LaminDB and annotate cell types.
say_en.note: Claude will create an artifact and add ontology annotations.

say_en.text: Query all datasets from PBMC tissue that are processed.
say_en.note: Claude will use LaminDB filtering to return results.

say_en.text: Trace the data lineage of this analysis workflow.
say_en.note: Claude will use view_lineage() to show provenance.
